title: Things I took *apart*, and built
subtitle: Not everything on my GitHub is worth your time. These are.

items.name: Termux Bootstrap Builder
items.tagline: Relocating a whole Linux userland to a new package name
items.description: Termux binaries hard-code /data/data/com.termux into their ELF interpreter, RUNPATH and shebangs, and a one-character-longer package name means you can't just hex-edit them. This GitHub Actions pipeline rebuilds the bootstrap from source for com.antigem, so AntiGem's standard variant can ship its own Linux environment.
highlights: Explains and fixes PT_INTERP / DT_RUNPATH path breakage
Fully automated aarch64 bootstrap builds in CI
Powers the Linux environment behind AntiGem

items.name: Hyprland Arch
items.tagline: My own Arch Linux distro, built in CI
items.description: A custom Arch ISO built with archiso inside a GitHub workflow: Hyprland on Wayland, a Calamares GUI installer, offline installation, and a JSON config you edit in Vim to set partitions, user and bootloader before installing.
highlights: Bootable ISO published from GitHub Actions releases
Offline install with a scripted, JSON-configured installer
Batteries included: kitty, Waybar, PipeWire, NvChad, VS Code, OBS

items.name: Hyper Compiler
items.description: A programming language of my own, written in JavaScript to learn compiler design by actually building one. Followed by a C++ compiler project built on the classic compiler-design algorithms.
highlights: Language designed and implemented from scratch in JavaScript

items.name: Realme Xposed Hooks
items.tagline: Nepali date, hooked into Android's system clock
items.description: Xposed hooks for my own phone: they put the Nepali (Bikram Sambat) date into the system UI by hooking system time and date, plus app mods and hooks for debugging and reverse engineering apps.
highlights: System-wide Bikram Sambat date via method hooking
Sibling project: an Xposed module that makes Gboard keys invisible for touch-typing practice

items.name: Spark
items.tagline: A web framework, from my own virtual DOM
items.description: A self-made web framework built on its own virtual DOM, written to understand what React actually does under the hood.
highlights: Built on its own virtual DOM

items.name: CodeWave
items.tagline: Stack Overflow meets a social feed
items.description: My 7th-semester CSIT project: a platform for coders to share problems and ideas. Real-time messaging, posts with syntax-highlighted code and images, runnable JS and Python snippets, voting, views, profiles, and a word2vec post recommender in Python. Built in about a month.
highlights: Run JS / Python snippets right from a post

items.name: Sahakari CLI
items.tagline: Update a fleet of Laravel apps with one command
items.description: A Rust CLI that updates many Laravel projects hosted on one server: update all or one, dry runs, error reports, verbose mode, forced updates and logs of previous runs.

items.name: Nepali Typing
items.description: A web app for typing Nepali, plus a PSC (Public Service Commission) typing-practice version for exam preparation.

items.name: PDF → Unicode
items.tagline: Rescuing Nepali text from scrambled PDFs
items.description: Copying text out of many Nepali PDFs gives garbage because of legacy fonts or deliberate scrambling. This Python tool maps glyphs back to Unicode by hand so the text comes out readable.
highlights: Extensible to other fonts and scripts

items.name: Loksewa App
items.tagline: MCQ prep for Nepal's civil service exam
items.description: A Flutter + Firebase Android app with categorized GK and IQ multiple-choice questions, authentication and an admin panel to add questions.

items.name: phphelper
items.tagline: A tiny PHP MVC library, on Composer
items.description: For people who find Laravel too heavy and raw PHP too repetitive: routing, controllers, middleware, MySQL, request/response, sessions and auth in four or five helper classes. Published on Composer.

items.name: Android ISO Mounter
items.tagline: Boot a PC from an ISO on your phone
items.description: A root shell script that mounts an ISO on the phone so a PC can boot from it, like a USB drive. An alternative for devices DriveDroid doesn't support.
highlights: Root + a couple of path variables
